questions.question: If a shopkeeper sold one-third of his goods at a loss of 20%, then at what gain % should the remainder be sold to gain 25% on the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper sells one-third of his goods at a loss of 20%.

A shopkeeper gains 25% on the whole transaction.

Formula Used:

Cost price × (100 + Profit %)/100 = Selling price

Cost price × (100 - Loss %)/100 = Selling price

Calculation:

Let the Cost price of his goods be 300,

Total profit = 300 × 25% = 75

Loss on one-third of his goods at a loss of 20% = 1/3 * 300 * 20/100

⇒ 20

Profit on two-third of his goods = 75 - (- 20) = 95

Profit% = (95/200) × 100 = 47.5%

∴ The value of two-thirds** of his goods** percentage is 47.5%

questions.question: In an examination, the ratio of practical to theory marks is 3 ∶ 7. If 80% of the marks are scored in the practical and 60% of marks are scored in the theory, what is the ratio of marks scored in the theory and the practical?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the marks of practical and theory marks is 3a and 7a

Marks scored by the student in theory = 3a × 80/100 = 2.4a

Marks scored by the student in practical = 7a × 60/100 = 4.2a

The ratio of marks scored in the theory and the practical = 4.2a: 2.4a

⇒ 7 : 4

**The ratio of marks scored in the theory and the practical is 7 : 4.**

questions.question: The perimeter of an isosceles right-angled triangle having an area of 200 cm² is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Area of triangle = 200 cm²

Concept used:

Using the concept of Pythagoras's theorem

Base² + Height² = Hypotenuse²

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3954312431f0cc2de9895f76b8ad0eb67051dff0d251948214fe14632ff1df0.png] 

Let the equal sides of the isosceles triangle be x cm

AB = BC = x

Area of triangle = 1/2 × BC × AB

⇒ 200 = 1/2 × x × x

⇒ x² = 400

⇒ x = 20 cm

AB = BC = 20 cm

By using Pythagoras's theorem

AB² + BC² = AC²

⇒ 20² + 20² = AC²

⇒ AC = 20√2 cm

⇒ AC = 20 * 1.41

⇒ AC = 28.2

The perimeter of triangle = 20 + 20 + 28.2

⇒ 68.3

**The perimeter of the triangle is 68.3 cm.**

questions.question: To buy a car, Sahil borrowed some amount at 10% simple interest rate. He has paid some loan amount but Rs. 1,81,500 is due which he has to pay in 3 years. What will be the annual installment (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Given:

The total amount due = 181500

The rate of interest is 10%.

The time is 3 years.

The type of installment is annual. 

Concept:

In simple all installments are always the same if no conditions apply.

Simple interest is where interest once credited does not earn interest on it.

Formula used:

Instalment = (100 × Amount)/{(100 × t) + (r × t × ((t – 1)/2))}

Where T is time and R is the rate of interest.

Calculation:

We calculate the first installment by using the formula:

Instalment = (100 × Amount)/{(100 × t) + (r × t × (t – 1)/2))}

Installment = (100 × 181500)/{(100 × 3) + (10 × 3 × ((3 – 1)/2))}

Installment = 18150000/(300 + 30)

Installment = 55000

**The annual instalment will be 55000.**

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days while B can the same work in 18 days. If they both work together, then how many days will be required to finish the work?
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Time taken by A = 12 days,

Time is taken by B = 18 days.

CALCULATION:

LCM of 12 and 18 = 36,

Total work = 36 unit

1 day work of A = 36/12 = 3 unit

1 day work of B = 36/18 = 2 unit

Time taken by both together to complete the whole work = 36 / 5

⇒ 7.2 days

**They both finish the work together in 7.2 days.**

questions.question: The largest number of four digits that is divisible by 12,15 and 18 is ________.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

L.C.M. of 12, 15, and 18 and = 180

The largest 4-digit number is 9999.

To find the largest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 12, 15, and 18 we have to divide the 9999 by 180 and subtract the remainder from 9999.

When we divide the 9999 by 180, the remainder is 99.

Required number = 9999 – 99 = 9900

**The largest number of four digits that is divisible by 12,15 and 18 is 9900.**

questions.question: Find the time taken by a 150 m long train, running at a speed of 63 km/h, to cross another train of length 100 m, running at a speed of 45 km/h in the same direction.
questions.solution:
Given:

Length of train = 150m

Speed of train = 63 km/h

Speed of another train of length 100 m = 45 km/hr

Concept Used:

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Total distance = 150 + 100

⇒ 250 m

Time = Total distance / Difference of speed

Time = 250/(18 × 5/18)

Time = 50 seconds

**The time one crosses another train is 50 seconds.**

questions.question: What annual installment will discharge a debt of Rs. 35,455 due in three years at 12% simple interest per annum (Installments will be paid at the end of the years)(Round off to nearest Rupee)?

The rate of interest is 12%.

The time is 3 years.

The type of instalment is annual. 

Concept:

In simple all instalments are always the same if no conditions apply.

Simple interest is where interest once credited does not earn interest on it.

Instalment = (100 × Amount)/{(100 × t) + (r × t × ((t – 1)/2))}

Where T is time and R is the rate of interest.

Calculation:

The total amount is Rs. 35,455.

The rate of interest is 12%.

The time is 3 years.

Then we calculate the first instalment by using the formula:

⇒ Instalment = (100 × Amount)/{(100 × t) + (r × t × (t – 1)/2))}

⇒ Installment = (100 × 35455)/{(100 × 3) + (12 × 3 × ((3 – 1)/2))}

questions.question: A person completes 80 km of a journey at 10 km/h and the remaining 70 km in 7 hours. His average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.solution:

A person completes 80 km of a journey at 10 km/h and the remaining 70 km in 7 hours

Average speed = total distance/total time

Calculation:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Total distance = 80 + 70

= 150 km

Total time = (80/10) + 7

= 8 + 7 = 15 hours

Average speed = 150/15

= 10 km/hr.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, one candidate got 60% of the valid votes. If the total number of votes polled were 8850, and 10% of the votes were invalid, then find the number of valid votes that the other candidate got.
questions.solution:
Given:

Total votes = 8850

Invalid votes = 10%

Percentage of votes one candidate got = 60%

Concept used:

a% of b = (ab)/100

Calculation:

Valid votes = (100 – 10)%= 90%

Total valid votes = 8850 × (90/100) = 7965

1st candidate got 60% of the total votes then 2ⁿd candidate got 40%

Valid votes of 2ⁿd candidate = 40% of Total valid votes

⇒ 7965 × (40/100)

⇒ 3186

∴ The other candidate's valid votes are 3186.

questions.question: A solid sphere has a surface area of 616 cm². This sphere is now cut into two hemispheres. What is the total surface area of one of the hemispheres?
questions.solution:
Given:

The surface area of the sphere = 616 cm²

Formula Used:

Surface area of sphere = 4 × πr²

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × πr³

Calculation:

Surface area of sphere = 4 × πr²

⇒ 616 = 4 × (22/7) × r²

⇒ r² = 616 × 7/88

⇒ r² = 7 × 7

⇒ r = 7

TSA of one of the spheres = 2πr² + πr2

⇒ 3πr2

⇒ 3 × (22/7) × (7)²

⇒ 3 × 22 × 7

⇒ 462

∴ The **total surface area of one of the hemispheres** is 462 cm².

questions.question: Mukesh sells almonds at the cost price but uses a false weight and thus gains a 23% profit. How many grams of almonds is he giving for 3.075 kg?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the shopkeeper sells at cost price, the profit of 23% is entirely due to false weight.

Ratio of Claimed Weight (SP) to Actual Weight (CP) = (100 + 23) : 100 = 123 : 100

Here, Claimed Weight = 3.075 kg = 3075 g

123 units → 3075 g

1 unit → 25 g

Actual Weight (100 units) = 25 × 100 = 2500 g

**∴ The correct answer is 2500 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Claimed Weight = 3.075 kg = 3075 g

Profit = 23%

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = [(Claimed Weight − Actual Weight) ÷ Actual Weight] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7777d720ec4ed784ac71742c86db56df4d9106e4bdf845f71ef8ac1037848116.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the actual weight given by Mukesh be x grams.

⇒ 23 = [(3075 − x) ÷ x] × 100

⇒ 23x = 307500 − 100x

⇒ 123x = 307500

⇒ x = 307500 ÷ 123

⇒ x = 2500

**∴ The correct answer is 2500 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer sells goods at Cost Price (CP) but uses a false weight, his Profit % is determined directly by the error in weight. Formula: Profit % = [Error ÷ (Claimed Weight − Error)] × 100.

Net Profit with Markup

If the dealer marks up his goods by a certain percentage and simultaneously cheats by using a false weight, the net profit is calculated by combining both effects using the ratio method or successive percentage formula.

Selling Price and Markup

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × [(100 − Discount%) ÷ 100]. This relationship helps identify the final price when a dealer offers a discount while committing weight fraud.

questions.question: A dishonest shopkeeper professes to sell grains at cost price, but he uses a weight of 935 g for 1 kg weight. Find his gain percentage.
questions.solution:
Given:

The dishonest dealer uses a false weight of 935 grams per 1 kg weight.

Formula used:

Gain = selling price - cost price.

Gain% = (gain/cost price) × 100

Calculations:

Let, 1kg = 1000g

The gain in weight = (1000g - 935g) = 65g.

Therefore, the gain percentage = (65/935) * 100

⇒ 0.0695 × 100

⇒ 6.95%

∴ The answer is 6.95%.

questions.question: X,Y and Z can do a piece of work in 4 days, 5 days and 7 days, respectively. They get Rs. 415 for completing the work. If X,Y and Z have worked together to complete the work, what is X's share?

​⇒ 28

(35 + 28 + 20) → 415

83 → 415

35 → 5 × 35 = 175

**X's share is 175.**

questions.question: A book is sold at a discount of 32% and an additional discount of 25% is allowed on cash payment. If Ramesh purchased the book by paying Rs. 2,550 in cash, find the marked price of the book.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A book is sold at a discount of 32% and an additional discount of 25% is allowed on cash payment.

Formula Used: 

Effective discount when two discounts are offered,

⇒ a + b - (a × b)/100

Calculation:

⇒ 25 + 32 - (15 × 35)/100

⇒ 57 - 8

⇒ 49%

Let the M.P be 100, then S.P:

⇒ 100 × (100 - 49)/100

⇒ 51

51 → 2550

100 → (2550 × 100)/51

100 → 5000

**The marked price of the book is 5000.**
